info.title: Socomarca API
info.description:
Backend of Socomarca's quick purchase platform (B2B ordering). Products, prices, customers and their
branches are synced from Random ERP; orders are sent back to Random ERP as sales documents.

## Authentication

1. Request a token with `POST /auth/token`, sending the user's email and password.
2. Send the token in every request: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

Requests without a valid token get `401`. Tokens of a user stop working as soon as the user is deactivated.

## Authorization

Access is granted by role permissions (roles: `superadmin`, `admin`, `supervisor`, `editor` and
`customer`). Each endpoint states the permission it requires; without it the API responds `403` with
`{"message": "You do not have permission."}`.

## Customers and branches

- Every Random ERP entity branch (entity code `user_code` + branch code `branch_code`) is a user with
  the `customer` role. `branch_type` tells whether it is the primary (`P`) or a secondary (`S`) branch.
- A primary branch can place orders for itself and for the active secondary branches of its entity:
  `GET /branches` lists them and `POST /orders/pay` receives the chosen one as `customer_id`. A secondary
  branch can only order for itself.
- The user who places an order always pays and is billed: catalog, cart and order use its price lists,
  credit payments use its credit line and the Random ERP sales note is issued for its branch. The branch
  in `customer_id` is the shipping branch: the order ships to one of its addresses.
- Customers log in with their commercial email (Random ERP `EMAILCOMER`). Their data is managed by the
  sync, so the administration can only activate or deactivate them.

## Conventions

- Requests and responses are JSON.
- Paginated lists accept `page` and `per_page`, and respond with `data`, `links` and `meta`.
- Validation errors respond `422` with `message` and an `errors` object keyed by field.
- Amounts are in Chilean pesos (CLP).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Log in with email and password and manage the session token and password.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Manage users (internal staff and customers synced from Random ERP) and the authenticated user's profile.

tags.name: Roles and permissions
tags.description: Roles, their permissions and the roles and permissions of each user.

tags.name: Branches
tags.description: Branches of the authenticated customer's Random ERP entity that it can place orders for.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Manage user addresses, and the regions and municipalities (comunas) they belong to.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Browse the product category tree synced from Random ERP: supercategories, categories and subcategories.

tags.name: Brands
tags.description: List the product brands synced from Random ERP.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Catalog synced from Random ERP, with the prices of the price lists each user may see, and product image uploads.

tags.name: Prices
tags.description: Prices synced from Random ERP, one per product, price list and unit.

tags.name: Favorites
tags.description: Named lists of favorite products (per sale unit) of the authenticated user.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: Shopping cart of the authenticated user, priced with the user's price lists.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: List the user's orders and check out the cart, paying with Webpay or the Random ERP credit line.

tags.name: Payment methods
tags.description: List the payment methods offered at checkout and enable or disable them.

tags.name: Webpay
tags.description: Settle, check and refund the Transbank Webpay Plus transactions started by `POST /orders/pay`.

tags.name: Credit lines
tags.description: Credit line of a customer branch in Random ERP.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Send push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging and track which ones each user has viewed.

tags.name: Firebase
tags.description: Manage the Firebase service account credentials used to send push notifications.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Sales dashboards over orders (charts, top customers, products, categories and municipalities, transactions) and Excel exports.

tags.name: FAQ
tags.description: Frequently asked questions. Reading and searching are public; managing them is limited to administrators.

tags.name: Site content
tags.description: Content shown in the store: contact details, social media links, terms of service, privacy policy and the customer message.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Store-wide settings: price quantity limits, VAT rate, maximum upload size and the Webpay configuration.

post.description:
Issues an API token for an active user. Customers log in with their commercial email (Random ERP
`EMAILCOMER`). The email is case-insensitive.

Unknown or inactive emails, emails assigned to more than one active user and wrong passwords
all respond 401, so that the response does not reveal whether an email is registered.

device_name.description: Name of the device, stored as the token name.

token.description: Bearer token to send in the `Authorization` header.

branch_type.description: Random ERP branch type: `P` primary, `S` secondary; `null` for internal users.

can_order_for_branches.description: Whether the user can place orders for other branches, so the frontend shows the branch selector.

weak_password.description: Whether the user still has the default password and should change it.

delete.description: Revokes the token used in the request.

get.description: Responds 200 while the token is valid, and 401 once it is revoked or its user is deactivated.
Profile of the authenticated user. The response is not wrapped in `data`.

put.description:
Stores the Firebase Cloud Messaging token of the authenticated user's device, used to send it
push notifications. Replaces the previous token.

fcm_token.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token of the device.

get.description:
Downloads an `.xlsx` file with the ID, name, email, phone and active state of the users with the
legacy `cliente` role. No role has that name anymore (customers have `customer`), so the file
currently only has the headings.

ID and name of every user, ordered by name, e.g. for report filters. Despite the path, the list
is not limited to customers.

post.description:
Filters users by field conditions and roles. Filters on unsupported fields are ignored. Allowed
fields and operators:

- `name`, `business_name`: `=`, `!=`, `LIKE`, `ILIKE`, `NOT LIKE`, `fulltext` (trigram similarity,
  results sorted by similarity).
- `email`, `rut`, `phone`: `=`, `!=`, `LIKE`, `ILIKE`, `NOT LIKE`.
- `is_active`: `=`, `!=`.
- `name_or_email`: matches `name` or `email`; `LIKE`/`ILIKE` (default `ILIKE`) match anywhere in the value.

For the other fields, `LIKE`-style operators don't add wildcards: include `%` in `value`.

Requires the `read-admin-users` permission.

filters.description: Field conditions, all of which must match. `operator` defaults to `=`; `sort` (`ASC`/`DESC`) also sorts by the field.

roles.description: Only users with any of these roles.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description: Users with `read-users` but without `read-admin-users` don't see `admin` and `superadmin` users.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Creates an internal user and emails it a welcome notification and its password. Assigning the
`admin` or `superadmin` role requires the `create-admin-users` permission; other roles require
`create-users`. The `customer` role cannot be assigned: customers are synced from Random ERP.

enum: No se pudo crear el usuario

password_generated.description: Whether the server generated the password. Always `false` while `password` is required.

get.description: `admin` and `superadmin` users require `read-admin-users`; other users require `read-users`.

put.description:
`PUT` requires every field (including `password`) and `PATCH` only the sent ones. Users can always
update themselves; updating others requires `update-users` and being able to view them.

Users synced from Random ERP (`is_synced`) only accept `is_active` and `fcm_token`; their other
fields are prohibited (422). Roles are replaced only when `roles` is not empty.

Every update emails the user a notification, and changing the password also emails the new
password. Deactivating a user revokes its tokens.

enum: No se pudo actualizar el usuario

password_changed.description: Whether the request changed the password.

delete.description:
Requires `delete-users` and being able to view the user; users cannot delete themselves. Users
with cart items or favorite lists cannot be deleted (422).

message.const: No se puede eliminar el usuario porque tiene datos asociados (carrito, listas de favoritos, etc.).

200.description: The user was deleted; the body is empty

Every permission that can be granted to roles.

Requires the `read-all-permissions` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Every role with the names of its permissions.

Every role with the users that have it.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

Roles of the user and all its permissions, through its roles or assigned directly.

get.summary: Show the roles of a user

Branches the authenticated user can place orders for besides itself, with their addresses,
ordered by name. Only primary branches (`branch_type` `P`) get results: the active secondary
branches of their Random ERP entity. For other users the list is empty.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
A branch the authenticated user can place orders for (itself or one of its orderable branches),
with its addresses. Branches it cannot order for respond 404, as nonexistent ones, so that their
existence is not revealed.

Lists the authenticated user's addresses, including the branch addresses synced from Random ERP.
Users with the `read-all-addresses` permission get the addresses of every user. Not paginated.

Allowed with the `read-own-addresses` or `read-all-addresses` permission.

post.description:
Creates an address for the authenticated user; its region is taken from the municipality. With
`is_default: true` the user's other addresses stop being the default one.

Allowed with the `create-addresses` permission.

get.description:
Users can see their own addresses (`read-own-addresses`), or any address with `read-all-addresses`.
The address is not wrapped in `data`.

put.description:
`PUT` requires every field below; `PATCH` updates only the fields sent. With `is_default: true` the
authenticated user's other addresses stop being the default one, and a new `municipality_id` also
updates the region.

Addresses synced from Random ERP (customer branches) cannot be updated (403). Users can update their
own addresses with `update-addresses`, or any address when they also have `read-all-addresses`.

message.const: The selected address has been updated

delete.description:
Responds 200 with an empty body. Addresses synced from Random ERP (customer branches) cannot be
deleted (403). Users can delete their own addresses with `delete-addresses`, or any address when they
also have `read-all-addresses`.

Lists every region, enabled or not, ordered by ID, each with its municipalities ordered by name.

Requires the `read-all-regions` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

Lists the municipalities of the region, enabled or not, ordered by name. An unknown region responds 422.

Requires the `read-all-regions` permission.
get.summary: List the municipalities of a region

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

Sets the status of the region and of all its municipalities.

Requires the `update-regions` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

Sets the status of the given municipalities. Their regions keep their own status.

Requires the `update-municipalities` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Downloads an Excel file with every category of the three levels, including disabled ones and those
without products.

Requires the `read-all-reports` permission.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Currently ignored: rows follow the database order.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
With `structure=nested` (the default) returns the storefront tree: the enabled supercategories that
have active products with a price visible to the user (customers only see their price lists), each
with its categories and subcategories filtered the same way, and the count of those products.

With `structure=flat` returns every category of the three levels as its own row, including disabled
ones and those without products, for the administration. It also requires the `read-all-reports`
permission (403 otherwise).

Requires the `read-all-categories` permission.

parameters.name: structure
parameters.description: `nested` returns the storefront tree, `flat` one row per category.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. In the nested tree it sorts the supercategories only. Unknown fields are ignored.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Returns the category of any level, without its children.

Requires the `read-all-categories` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

post.description:
Returns the same tree as the nested category list, keeping only the supercategories that match
`filters`. Product counts are not computed here: use the category list for them.

Requires the `read-all-categories` permission.

filters.description: Conditions on the supercategories, all of which must match. `field` is `name` or `description` (operators `=`, `!=`, `LIKE`, `ILIKE`, `NOT LIKE` and `fulltext`, a trigram similarity search that also orders by similarity), `code` (the same except `fulltext`), `level` (`=`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`) or `enabled` (`=`, `!=`). Unknown fields and operators are ignored. The optional `sort` (`ASC` or `DESC`) also orders by the field.

sort.description: Field to sort the supercategories by. Unknown fields are ignored.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Lists every subcategory with its parent category. Not paginated. These come from the legacy
subcategories table, which the Random ERP sync does not fill: the synced subcategories are the
third level of the category list.

Requires the `read-all-subcategories` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Returns a subcategory of the legacy subcategories table with its parent category.

Requires the `read-all-subcategories` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Lists, sorted by name, the brands with at least one active product that has a visible price: active,
in stock, above zero (unless zero prices are enabled in the configuration) and, for customers, on one
of their price lists. Not paginated.

Requires the `read-all-brands` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

post.description:
First step of the product image sync: returns a presigned S3 URL, valid for 5 minutes, where the
client uploads with `PUT` a ZIP of product images. The ZIP must contain an `images/` folder with
one image per product named after its SKU (e.g. `images/SKU-12345.jpg`; jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp,
bmp or svg). Then send the returned `path` to Sync product images.

Requires the `sync-product-images` permission.
post.summary: Create a product images upload URL

presigned_upload_url.description: Presigned URL to upload the ZIP with `PUT`.

host.description: `Host` header to send with the upload.

path.description: Storage path of the ZIP, to send as `sync_file_path` to Sync product images.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

post.description:
Queues the processing of a ZIP uploaded with Create a product images upload URL and responds
right away. Each image is assigned to the product with the SKU of its file name, replacing its
current image; images without a matching product are skipped. The ZIP is deleted afterwards.

Requires the `sync-product-images` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Returns the lowest and highest active price, rounded to whole pesos, to set the bounds of the
price filter. Considers the active prices of every price list, regardless of the user's price
lists and of stock.

Requires the `read-all-prices` permission.

parameters.name: vat
parameters.description: Return the prices with VAT included, matching the prices shown by List products.

lowest_price_product.description: Lowest active price, or `null` when there are no active prices.

highest_price_product.description: Highest active price, or `null` when there are no active prices.

vat.description: VAT rate (percentage) included in the prices; `0` when they are net.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

Returns one row per product, price list and unit: only active products with an active, in-stock
price (zero prices are hidden unless enabled in the configuration). Customers only get rows of

Also accepts the filters below as query parameters. They are not validated, so prefer
Search products to filter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Search text, fuzzy-matched against the name and partially matched against the SKU. Without `sort`, results are ordered by similarity.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. `price` and `stock` sort by the price of each row.

Returns the product with all its prices, of every price list and unit, regardless of the user's

`extra` lists the supercategories, categories, subcategories and brands present in the matching

Returns every stored price, of all price lists and including inactive ones, without pagination.

Requires the `read-all-prices` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's favorite lists, without their products.

post.description: Creates an empty favorite list for the authenticated user.

get.description: Shows a favorite list with its products. Only the owner of the list can see it.

put.description: Only the owner of the list can rename it.

delete.description:
Deletes the list together with its favorites. Only the owner of the list can delete it. Responds 200
with an empty body.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's favorite lists, each with its favorite products.

post.description:
Adds a product unit to one of the authenticated user's favorite lists. Adding a product unit that
is already in the list returns the existing favorite. Lists of other users respond 403.
post.summary: Add a product to a favorite list

delete.description:
Removes a product unit from its favorite list. Only the owner of the list can remove it. Responds
200 with an empty body.

get.description:
Lists the authenticated user's cart items with the active price of their unit in the user's price
lists, and the cart total. Prices are resolved as Pay the cart does (the first list, in the user's
order, that prices the product and unit), so the total is the one charged. Items without such a
price show a price and subtotal of 0, and Pay the cart rejects them.

Requires the `read-own-cart` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

delete.description:
Deletes every item of the authenticated user's cart.

Requires the `delete-cart` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

post.description:
Re-adds the products of a previous order to the authenticated user's cart, with the order's
quantities and units. Products already in the cart with the same unit get their quantity increased.
Prices are not taken from the order: the returned cart is priced as Show the cart.

Allowed for orders the user placed or orders placed for the user (as customer); other orders respond 403.

Requires the `create-orders` permission.
post.summary: Add the items of an order to the cart

500.description: Unexpected error; no item is added to the cart

message.const: Error al agregar productos al carrito
Productos de la orden agregados al carrito exitosamente

added_items.description: Number of order lines added to the cart as new items.

updated_items.description: Number of order lines that increased the quantity of an existing cart item.

post.description:
Adds the quantity of a product unit to the authenticated user's cart. If the cart already has that
product with the same unit, its quantity is increased instead. The product must have an active price
for the unit.

Requires the `create-cart-items` permission.
post.summary: Add an item to the cart

price.description: Unit price from the user's price lists; 0 when the user has no active price for the unit.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item in the cart after adding.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

delete.description:
Subtracts the quantity from the authenticated user's cart item for the product unit, and deletes the
item when its quantity reaches 0. Removing more than the item's quantity responds 422. If the cart has
no item for the product unit, it responds 200 with the message `Product item not found`.

Requires the `delete-cart-items` permission.
delete.summary: Remove a quantity of an item from the cart

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Sale unit of the cart item.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Quantity to remove. It cannot exceed the quantity of the cart item.

message.const: Product item quantity has been removed from cart

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Lists the orders placed by the authenticated user and the orders placed for it (by its primary
branch), with their items, payments and customer.

Requires the `read-own-orders` permission.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Other values fall back to `created_at`.

parameters.name: sort_direction
parameters.description: Sort direction. Other values fall back to `desc`.

parameters.name: payment_method_code
parameters.description: Only orders with a payment made with this payment method code.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

post.description:
Creates an order out of the authenticated user's cart and starts its payment. The order ships to
`customer_id` (the user itself by default): a primary branch can also order for the active
secondary branches of its entity. The authenticated user always pays and is billed: items are
priced with its price lists (the first list, in the user's order, that prices the product and
unit), as in the cart, and the prices, VAT and shipping cost are frozen on the order. Shipping is
free from a net subtotal of 70,000.

The order is sent to Random ERP as a sales note (NVV) issued for the authenticated user's entity
and branch, with the branch of `customer_id` as the shipping branch.

`payment_method` decides how the order is paid:

- `random_credit`: the amount is charged to the authenticated user's Random ERP credit line and the
  sales note is created right away. Failures also respond 200, with `success: false` and one of
  these messages:
  - `Línea de crédito bloqueada`: a previous credit order of the user is not invoiced in Random
    ERP yet. The order is left pending.
  - `Crédito insuficiente`: the available credit does not cover the amount; `data.credit_status`
    has the credit summary from Random ERP. The order is left pending.
  - `Creación de nota de venta fallida`: Random ERP rejected the sales note. The order and its
    payment are marked failed.

  On success the order is completed with its `random_document_number`, the cart is emptied and the
  user's credit line is blocked until Random ERP invoices the sales note.
- Any other method pays with Webpay: the response has the pending order and the Transbank
  `payment_url` and `token`. Send the buyer to `payment_url` posting the token as `token_ws`;
  Transbank sends the buyer back to the configured return URL with `token_ws`, which must be passed
  to `GET /webpay/return` to settle the order. The cart is kept until the payment is authorized.

Requires the `update-orders` permission.

200.description: Webpay transaction created (`data`), or result of the credit payment (`success`)

message.const: Creación de nota de venta fallida

422.description: Validation error, or some cart products have no active price in the user's price lists (`products`)

message.const: Algunos productos del carrito no tienen precio vigente
La orden no está pendiente de pago

500.description: The Webpay transaction could not be created (the order is left pending), or the credit payment failed unexpectedly

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Lists the enabled payment methods. Their `code` is the `payment_method` sent to `POST /orders/pay`.

Requires the `read-all-payment-methods` permission.

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

put.description:
Disabled methods are no longer listed by `GET /payment-methods`.

Requires the `update-payment-methods` permission.
put.summary: Enable or disable a payment method

message.const: The payment method has been updated

403.description: The user does not have the required permission

get.description:
Receives the parameters Transbank sends back with the buyer after the Webpay form, and settles the
order:

- With `token_ws`, commits the transaction in Transbank and stores the result: the order becomes
  `completed` when the payment is `AUTHORIZED` and `failed` otherwise. On authorization the cart of
  the user who placed the order is emptied, the order emails are sent and the sales note (NVV) is
  created in Random ERP in the background. A token can be committed only once: repeating it, or
  sending an unknown token, responds 500.
- With `TBK_TOKEN` (the buyer canceled the payment), the payment is marked failed and the response
  is 400.
- Without either of them (the Webpay form timed out), responds 408.

parameters.name: token_ws
parameters.description: Token of the transaction, sent by Transbank when the payment was completed or rejected.

parameters.name: TBK_TOKEN
parameters.description: Token of the transaction, sent by Transbank instead of `token_ws` when the buyer canceled the payment.

500.description: The transaction could not be committed, or its payment does not exist

200.description: Transaction committed; `success` tells whether the payment was authorized

get.description: Queries Transbank for the current status of a transaction, without changing the order or its payment.
get.summary: Get the status of a Webpay transaction

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token of the transaction, as returned by `POST /orders/pay`.

500.description: Transbank could not report the status, for example because the token is unknown

post.description:
Refunds all or part of an authorized transaction in Transbank and marks its payment as `refunded`.
The order status is not changed.

token.description: Token of the transaction, as returned by `POST /orders/pay`.

500.description: Transbank rejected the refund, or the payment of the token does not exist

get.description:
Credit line of the user's Random ERP branch (`user_code` + `branch_code`), with the fields returned
by Random ERP: `CRSD` is the credit limit and `CRSDVU` the used amount, so the available credit is
`CRSD - CRSDVU`. Users with `read-all-credit-lines` can see any user's credit line; users with
`read-own-credit-lines` only their own.

After a credit payment the credit line is `blocked` until the pending payment is processed: the
response is then the locally stored state, which already includes that order in `CRSDVU`, and
Random ERP is not queried. Otherwise (`unblocked`) the data comes from Random ERP.

Random ERP errors respond `{message, detail}`: 404 when Random ERP has no credit line for the
